rollback_evidence: 1.0.12 junos port ownership (J31-J33), measured on vJunos-switch 26.2R1.7 (vJunos-switch, virtual KVM, verification record) with the safeguard of the Junos interface profile: an empty 'commit confirmed 10 comment "netops-<id>"' first, the change committed with 'commit confirmed 10 comment "netops-change"', the confirmation 'commit comment "netops-<id>-ok"'; an expiry returns the configuration before the change. The one key 'system' holds 'set system host-name <name>' (labels separated by dots, measured 'vjunos-switch.junos port ownership' in the candidate; a configured name outside the attribute pattern refuses the system table before a change, so the undo can always return the name read from the device; the CLI prompt shows the new name right after the commit, in the same session; Admin accepts the old and the new name in its sessions), 'set system domain-name <fqdn>' / 'delete system domain-name', the ordered name-servers 'set system name-server <ip>' (a set server goes to the end, so the servers from the first difference on are deleted and set again in the wanted order; the common head is not touched) and 'set system ntp source-address <ip>' (a list on Junos: a new address is set after the old one is deleted). A name-server or source-address with further options, more than one source-address, system statements from groups and deactivated statements are refused.
